about.title: About Words of Praise
about.description: A modern web application for daily Bible verses with favorites, comments, and history tracking.
about.missionText: To provide daily spiritual inspiration through God's Word, making it accessible and meaningful for everyone.
about.subtitle: Daily Inspiration Through God's Word
about.feature1Desc: Receive a new inspirational Bible verse every day at midnight
about.feature2Desc: Save and organize your favorite verses for easy access
about.feature3Desc: Browse past daily verses using back and forward arrows right on the home screen. Sign in to access up to 30 days of verse history.
about.feature4Desc: Add your own reflections and thoughts to any verse
about.feature5Desc: Comfortable reading experience day or night
about.feature6Desc: Beautiful and responsive on all devices
about.ctaDesc: Create a free account to save your favorite verses, browse past daily verses, add personal reflections, and more. Sign up takes less than a minute!
about.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign In
about.contactDesc: We'd love to hear from you! Whether you've found a bug, have a suggestion, or just want to share your thoughts, please reach out.
about.instagramUpdate: 📱 Stay updated with daily inspiration and app updates
